description: 1-RC Equivalent Circuit Model with SOC-dependent parameters
source: Copetti et al. (1993), J. Power Sources; Manwell & McGowan (1993), Sol. Energy

cell.name: Generic 12V/100Ah Flooded Lead-Acid (6 cells in series)

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 (3rd-order for lead-acid)
ocv_coefficients.source: Copetti et al. (1993) modified Shepherd model

soc_dependent_params.description: SOC-dependent multipliers for R0, R1, C1.
soc_dependent_params.note: factor(SOC) = b0 + b1*SOC + b2*SOC^2. Lead-acid shows strong resistance rise at low SOC.
